summary: 发票税额资格确认与跨 owner 编排（复用 PH-252）on BASE 863f946. Does not reimplement invoice record/tax split/reversal: those stay in PH-252. Adds invoicing/migrations/0002_tax_qualification_guard.py which replaces only the TaxQualification append-only guard with vendor-aware SQLite/PG rules allowing pending->confirmed (recoverable/not_recoverable, decided_on/evidence/version change) and confirmed->superseded (status/version only), while keeping source_ref/tax_cents/created_at immutable and DELETE forbidden. Adds services: open_tax_qualification (pending fact for an existing invoice/line/allocation/reversal source, tax <= source tax), confirm_tax_qualification (owner/finance, company lock, request_token/expected_version, period/lock checks, evidence, plugin audit, no ledger/cost/revenue/cash writes), supersede_tax_qualification (old confirmed->superseded plus appended replacement confirmed fact preserving history), and link_invoice_orchestration (validates invoice/reversal ownership and the referenced owner fact for management-revenue reversal / cash refund / bank return / settlement adjustment incl. settlement/clearance/open-item refs; records the append-only reference chain in AuditEvent with plugin action, does not mutate other owners and does not claim a global single transaction). Adds read-only invoice_tax_snapshot/list with qualification history, effective qualification, orchestration reference chain and frozen issues (tax_qualification_missing/pending/superseded, orchestration_ref_missing, not_recoverable_costing_review_required); missing is null+missing, never zero. Adds invoicing/invoice_tax.html plus invoice-tax history_read page and invoice-tax-confirm/link business_write routes (owner/finance write, auditor read, member denied, disabled-module history read). No new canonical topic/command, no contract schema or applied-migration edits, no other-owner writes. Tests: 8 scoped (4 service incl. append-only/DB trigger probes, supersede, permissions/period, orchestration chain after reversal; 3 HTTP; plus existing PH-252 invoice suite). Actual runs: check ok/task_count=263; manage.py check exit0; makemigrations no changes; fresh SQLite verify ok; scoped 8 OK; full 1169/140.002s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures. Deviations: PM project-level summary is impossible because Invoice has no project FK, so PM is denied detail/list (disclosed); orchestration is reference recording/validation only (owner writes must be performed first by the corresponding named owner service; invoicing does not invoke them), so no false single-transaction claim; no tax/orchestration verifier branch because core verify_integrity is outside the PH-320 allowlist (fresh DB passes; trigger probes included in tests); models.py unchanged. Reviewer round-1 blockers fixed: (1) link_invoice_orchestration now requires a matching InvoiceReversal for all cross-owner link kinds, validates the declared namespace/kind of each owner ref, derives the invoice project/counterparty source set from its allocations, and checks the referenced owner fact project/source and counterparty against that set (revenue adjustment, settlement/clearance/open-item and cash-refund/bank-return counterparty); cross-project/foreign and missing-reversal cases reject with zero writes, with regressions. (2) TaxQualification INSERT is now guarded by vendor-aware triggers requiring status pending, qualification_status unknown, decided_on NULL and version 1; supersede now appends a pending row then transitions it, so no direct confirmed/superseded insert is possible; a direct-insert probe covers this. (3) confirm_tax_qualification appends the confirmation evidence to the pending evidence instead of overwriting it, and supersede keeps the old evidence in the superseded row/replacement; tests assert the open evidence survives. The earlier PH-252 reuse/migration-only guard replacement/permissions/audit/no-ledger-write behaviour is unchanged.

review.reviewer: independent PH-320 invoice tax/orchestration reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - cross-owner link validation is insufficient: `link_invoice_orchestration` validates only that the referenced owner row exists in the same org; it does not verify the row belongs to the invoice's project/source or that a reversal is involved. `reversal_id` is optional, and `_owner_ref_value` ignores the declared namespace/kind for revenue/cash kinds (it fetches by id), so a revenue adjustment, cash refund/bank return or settlement fact from another project/customer can be linked to an invoice. This does not meet the task's 'same org/project/source + invoice/reversal attribution' requirement. Fix: derive the invoice's project/source set (via its allocations) and validate the owner fact's project/source against it; require the relevant InvoiceReversal for reversal/refund link kinds (or reject those without one); validate the owner ref namespace/kind; add cross-project/foreign-owner rejection tests.

BLOCKER - the TaxQualification DB guard does not enforce the initial state on INSERT: migration 0002's PG function returns NEW unconditionally for INSERT and its SQLite migration has no insert guard, while the model `save` only blocks updates. Direct ORM/DB insertion can therefore create a `confirmed` or `superseded` TaxQualification without pending->confirmed history, bypassing the frozen append-only state machine. Fix: add a vendor-aware INSERT guard requiring the initial status pending/unknown (version 1) (or otherwise prove/validate the only allowed initial state), and add a direct-insert probe test.

BLOCKER - confirmation overwrites the pending evidence instead of preserving it: `confirm_tax_qualification` updates the row with the new evidence and thereby loses the evidence submitted at open; the requirement says evidence/decided_on must be retained/auditable. Fix: append the new confirmation evidence to the existing evidence (or store the previous payload in an immutable audit/snapshot) so the open evidence remains recoverable; update the confirmation test to assert preservation.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: PH-252 record/allocate/reverse is not reimplemented; migration 0002 only replaces the TaxQualification guard; confirmation is pending->confirmed with recoverable/not_recoverable, decided_on/evidence/version, owner/finance+company lock+expected_version/period and plugin audit; supersede marks old confirmed and appends a replacement; no ledger/cost/revenue/cash writes; UI invoice-tax history_read + confirm/link business_write; role boundaries and disabled-module history reads; canonical delivery/urls binding, no invoicing/urls.py; 15 changed files within the PH-320 whitelist; no core migration. Full suite 1169/5F+3E/69 known baseline; check 263; makemigrations clean; scoped 8+PH-252 18 OK; fresh verify_integrity ok; verify-change only review/acceptance gates, no path_out_of_scope. PM inability and orchestration-only-reference/verifier absence are disclosed.
review.evidence: reviewer round-1 REJECTED (owner-link attribution insufficient; TaxQualification INSERT unrestricted; confirmation overwrote pending evidence). Fixed: links require a matching InvoiceReversal plus namespace/kind/project/counterparty validation derived from invoice allocations; INSERT guard now allows only pending/unknown/v1 and supersede appends a pending row before transition; confirmation appends evidence and preserves the open payload. Cross-project, missing-reversal, direct-insert and evidence-preservation regressions added. Round-2 independent review pending; implementer does not self-pass.
